items.after:
Create the minimal game scaffold:

- `index.html` — a single HTML page with one `<script type="module" src="src/main.js"></script>` tag (the ES-module approach KAPLAY recommends for a no-bundler setup).
- `src/main.js` — imports KAPLAY from a pinned CDN and initializes it:

  ```js
  import kaplay from "https://unpkg.com/kaplay@3001.0.19/dist/kaplay.mjs";
  kaplay({ background: "#1a1a1a" });
  ```

  `kaplay()` starts KAPLAY's built-in render loop and creates a blank canvas. The dark background makes the canvas visible (proving it rendered) against the page background.

`src/` is where the later files (map, actors, AI) will live.

Done when: opening the page (served via `python3 -m http.server`) shows a blank dark canvas with no console errors.
